description: This file defines the `BuzzLikeDao` class in PHP that manages database operations related to 'likes' on social media shares and comments within the Buzz module of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, deleting, and retrieving 'like' records, utilizing Doctrine query builders and external DTOs for filtering.

classes.name: BuzzLikeDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class that handles CRUD operations and queries related to BuzzLike entities for shares and comments.

methods.name: saveBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Persists a BuzzLikeOnShare entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: saveBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Persists a BuzzLikeOnComment entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: deleteBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Deletes a BuzzLikeOnShare record based on share ID and employee number.

methods.name: deleteBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Deletes a BuzzLikeOnComment record based on comment ID and employee number.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnShareByShareIdAndEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzLikeOnShare entity based on share ID and employee number.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnCommentByShareIdAndEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzLikeOnComment entity based on comment ID and employee number.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnShareList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of BuzzLikeOnShare entities matching provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnShareCount
methods.description: Returns the count of BuzzLikeOnShare entities matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnCommentList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of BuzzLikeOnComment entities matching provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnCommentCount
methods.description: Returns the count of BuzzLikeOnComment entities matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnShareQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds and returns a QueryBuilderWrapper for BuzzLikeOnShare with applied filters and sorting.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnCommentQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds and returns a QueryBuilderWrapper for BuzzLikeOnComment with applied filters and sorting.
